messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Feb 07, 2022, Suguna Sakkiah wrote:
>
>The test cuda parallel shows the below message.
First, are you actually planning to run CUDA jobs in parallel?  This is
somewhat rare.
>145 file comparisons passed
>3 file comparisons failed (0 of which can be ignored)
>0 tests experienced errors
>Test log file saved as /data/Amber/amber20/logs/test_amber_cuda_parallel/2022-02-07_17-41-32.log
>Test diffs file saved as /data/Amber/amber20/logs/test_amber_cuda_parallel/2022-02-07_17-41-32.diff
You need to look in the "test diffs" file above to see what the errors are,
and whether the diffs look important or very minor.
....dac
